parts.name: main body

physics.Basic_description: Large red painted metal housing with a bulbous central chamber and cylindrical extensions.
physics.Functional_description: Encloses the fan mechanism and directs airflow from intake to outlet.
physics.Grasped_description: Grasp the main bulbous body firmly from the side to support the object's weight.
physics.reason: Sheet metal housing for a blower is a thin shell enclosing air and internal components.

parts.description: Large red painted metal housing with a bulbous central chamber and cylindrical extensions.
parts.function: Encloses the fan mechanism and directs airflow from intake to outlet.

parts.name: outlet socket

physics.Basic_description: Green plastic collar connecting the main body to the nozzle tube.
physics.Functional_description: Provides a sealed connection point between the housing and the nozzle assembly.
physics.Grasped_description: Too small and recessed to be a primary grasp point.
physics.reason: Molded plastic connector ring is a thin-walled cylinder.

parts.description: Green plastic collar connecting the main body to the nozzle tube.
parts.function: Provides a sealed connection point between the housing and the nozzle assembly.

parts.name: intake grille

physics.Basic_description: Circular grille with radial slats on the side of the housing, painted red/brown.
physics.Functional_description: Allows air intake while protecting the internal fan blades from debris.
physics.Grasped_description: Fragile slats make this unsuitable for grasping.
physics.reason: The grille consists of solid metal slats/spokes, though the assembly has open space.

parts.description: Circular grille with radial slats on the side of the housing, painted red/brown.
parts.function: Allows air intake while protecting the internal fan blades from debris.

parts.name: housing foot

physics.Basic_description: Small red metal tab or foot extending from the bottom of the housing.
physics.Functional_description: Provides a mounting point or stability when placed on a surface.
physics.Grasped_description: Too small and awkwardly positioned for a stable grasp.
physics.reason: Likely a stamped metal tab or small solid bracket.

parts.description: Small red metal tab or foot extending from the bottom of the housing.
parts.function: Provides a mounting point or stability when placed on a surface.

parts.name: metal tube

physics.Basic_description: Long, ribbed orange/gold metallic tube extending from the front.
physics.Functional_description: Directs the high-velocity air stream to the target area.
physics.Grasped_description: Can be grasped along its length, though the ribs might make it slippery.
physics.reason: Nozzle tubes are hollow pipes to allow airflow.

parts.description: Long, ribbed orange/gold metallic tube extending from the front.
parts.function: Directs the high-velocity air stream to the target area.

parts.name: base sleeve

physics.Basic_description: Dark grey/black sleeve at the base of the nozzle tube.
physics.Functional_description: Secures the nozzle tube to the housing outlet.
physics.Grasped_description: Small and recessed, not a primary grasp target.
physics.reason: Sleeve is a cylindrical shell fitting over or into the tube.

parts.description: Dark grey/black sleeve at the base of the nozzle tube.
parts.function: Secures the nozzle tube to the housing outlet.

parts.name: retaining ring

physics.Basic_description: Thin metallic ring near the nozzle connection.
physics.Functional_description: Retains the nozzle assembly in place.
physics.reason: Retaining rings are typically solid wire or strip metal.

parts.description: Thin metallic ring near the nozzle connection.
parts.function: Retains the nozzle assembly in place.

parts.name: adjustment rib

physics.Basic_description: Ribbed texture on the nozzle tube surface.
physics.Functional_description: Provides grip for adjusting or rotating the nozzle if applicable.
physics.Grasped_description: Part of the nozzle surface, not a separate graspable entity.
physics.reason: Ribs are solid protrusions on the tube wall.

parts.description: Ribbed texture on the nozzle tube surface.
parts.function: Provides grip for adjusting or rotating the nozzle if applicable.

parts.name: crank hub

physics.Basic_description: Central pinkish/metallic hub where the crank arm attaches.
physics.Functional_description: Transfers torque from the crank arm to the drive shaft.
physics.Grasped_description: Small and central, difficult to grasp without interfering with rotation.
physics.reason: Hub must be solid to transmit torque without deforming.

parts.description: Central pinkish/metallic hub where the crank arm attaches.
parts.function: Transfers torque from the crank arm to the drive shaft.

parts.name: crank arm

physics.Basic_description: Lime green/yellowish metal rod extending from the hub.
physics.Functional_description: Lever arm for the user to rotate the fan mechanism.
physics.Grasped_description: Grasp the middle of the arm to rotate the crank.
physics.reason: Crank arms are typically solid rods or bars for strength.

parts.description: Lime green/yellowish metal rod extending from the hub.
parts.function: Lever arm for the user to rotate the fan mechanism.

parts.name: grip pin

physics.Basic_description: Small teal pin connecting the grip to the arm.
physics.Functional_description: Axle allowing the grip to rotate freely on the arm end.
physics.reason: Pins are solid cylinders.

parts.description: Small teal pin connecting the grip to the arm.
parts.function: Axle allowing the grip to rotate freely on the arm end.

parts.name: rotating grip

physics.Basic_description: Brown cylindrical wooden handle at the end of the crank arm.
physics.Functional_description: Provides a comfortable, rotating surface for the user's hand to turn the crank.
physics.Grasped_description: Primary interaction point; grasp the cylinder to rotate the mechanism.
physics.reason: Handles are typically solid wood or plastic for durability and feel.

parts.description: Brown cylindrical wooden handle at the end of the crank arm.
parts.function: Provides a comfortable, rotating surface for the user's hand to turn the crank.

parts.name: drive shaft

physics.Basic_description: Maroon/dark red vertical shaft extending downwards from the housing.
physics.Functional_description: Transmits rotational force from the external crank to the internal fan.
physics.reason: Drive shafts must be solid to transmit torque efficiently.

parts.description: Maroon/dark red vertical shaft extending downwards from the housing.
parts.function: Transmits rotational force from the external crank to the internal fan.

parts.name: drive collar

physics.Basic_description: Navy blue ring/collar on the drive shaft.
physics.Functional_description: Secures the shaft position or acts as a bearing surface.
physics.Grasped_description: Too small and internal to grasp.
physics.reason: Collars are typically thick-walled rings.

parts.description: Navy blue ring/collar on the drive shaft.
parts.function: Secures the shaft position or acts as a bearing surface.

parts.name: fan wheel

physics.Basic_description: Olive green multi-bladed fan visible through the intake grille.
physics.Functional_description: Rotates to generate airflow when the crank is turned.
physics.Grasped_description: Enclosed and fragile, do not grasp.
physics.reason: Fan blades are thin but solid material sheets.

parts.description: Olive green multi-bladed fan visible through the intake grille.
parts.function: Rotates to generate airflow when the crank is turned.

parts.name: fan hub

physics.Basic_description: Gray central hub of the fan wheel.
physics.Functional_description: Connects the fan blades to the drive shaft.
physics.Grasped_description: Internal component, not accessible for grasping.
physics.reason: Hub must be solid to mount blades and shaft.

parts.description: Gray central hub of the fan wheel.
parts.function: Connects the fan blades to the drive shaft.

simulation.collision: CoACD convex decomposition of concave source collision meshes (relative tolerance 0.03–0.05)

collisionFilter.description: Self-contact excluded between directly connected rigid groups, including the fixed base; nonadjacent contacts retained

simulation.inertia: Source URDF link inertials; missing inertials use geometry-derived defaults (density 1000 kg/m³)
simulation.friction: Source URDF mu1 as sliding friction; torsional 0.005, rolling 0.0001
simulation.contact: MuJoCo soft contacts (solref 0.01 1); source restitution is displayed, not converted
simulation.material: Rigid bodies; Young’s modulus and Poisson ratio are annotations, not soft-body parameters

interaction.description: Switchable virtual joint damping and reflected armature for interactive inspection; source properties are unchanged.
interaction.rule: damping ≥ rated effort / rated speed; armature = 2% child subtree mass (slide) or 2% mass × collision radius² (hinge)
